units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale anywhere

camera.motion: static: lamp post, hydrant, windows identical in frame 0 and 77 (background shift 0 px)
camera.view: side-on street view, looking perpendicular at a building facade across a road; building verticals and lamp post are vertical and curb/road lines horizontal, so no visible pitch/roll; principal point assumed at image centre (540,540)
camera.horizon_note: not visible (building blocks it). For a level camera the horizon is at the principal-point row ~540 (an assumption). With it, ground-contact rows give relative depth ~ 1/(y_contact - 540): car tyres y 865 (325 px below), lamp/hydrant bases y ~897 (357), man's feet y ~945 (405). So man is nearest, then lamp/hydrant, then car (car about 1.25x the man's depth). Only a rough cue.

objects.name: car
objects.desc: orange sports sedan (fastback, black wheels, red brake callipers), drives left to right in the near road lane
objects.visible_frames: 21-77 (nose enters at left edge at frame 21; fully in frame 49-50 only; front leaves the right edge at frame 69)
objects.reference_point: centre_x = middle of the horizontal silhouette extent; centre_y = middle of bbox rows (vehicle root presumably on the ground below it, ground_y 865)

size_px.note: constant through the clip (moves parallel to the image plane, constant depth): height 219 px every frame 40-77; length measured at frames 49-50 (740.2, 739.2)

objects.name: man
objects.desc: pedestrian in dark navy jacket, grey trousers, black beanie, black shoes; walks right to left along the near sidewalk, in front of (nearer than) the hydrant, lamp post and car
objects.visible_frames: 0-77 (right part cut by the right image edge in 0-17 and 25-30, legs swing past it)
objects.reference_point: pelvis_x = head centre + 3 px (median torso-head offset in clean frames); pelvis_y = feet_y - 0.53*height (estimate)

height_head_top_to_shoe_sole.note: per-frame values in man.csv; +-5 px noise from shoe-sole detection; head top 573-580

objects.name: lamp_post
objects.desc: black cast-iron street lamp on the near sidewalk edge, left of the hydrant

objects.name: fire_hydrant
objects.desc: white fire hydrant with rusty caps, on the near sidewalk right of the lamp post
objects.visible_frames: 0-77 (partly hidden behind the man around frames 0-35)

objects.name: building
objects.desc: white-painted brick building facade behind the far sidewalk; fills x 0-~900

objects.name: windows
objects.desc: 4 visible sash windows in 2 columns x 2 rows (plus cut ones at the left edge x 0-30)

objects.name: graffiti

objects.name: road

objects.name: sidewalks

objects.name: trees

events.note: walks left the whole clip; never stops; ~3-4.5 px/frame

events.event: car nose enters at left image edge
car front reaches lamp post (front hidden from here)
man starts to pass in front of the car

events.note: per-frame centre step falls from ~29-30 px (frames 22-26) to ~8 px (frame 77) roughly linearly from about frame 30; earlier steps noisy (nose only, blur). Car still moving at the last frame (does not stop).

events.event: man passes in front of the hydrant / lamp post
events.frames: hydrant ~0-40, lamp post ~68-77 (lamp axis x 813; man pelvis x crosses 813 between frames 74 (816.0) and 75 (812.5))

apparent_size_over_time.car: constant height 219 px and length ~740 px -> constant depth (lateral motion)
apparent_size_over_time.man: height 361-380 px with no trend (gait bob only), head width constant 51 px -> constant depth
